g.text: Class diagram - api, services and config (src/p14_search/api, services.py, config.py, unibridge_profile.py)
+create_app(settings : Settings [0..1], services : Services [0..1], init_services : bool) : FastAPI
+build_services(settings, store, qdrant, embedder, registry, llm_provider) : Services
The one place where objects are wired. Tests and scripts
call it with their own store, Qdrant client, embedder,
registry or LLM provider (FakeProvider in the tests).
UniBridge = the same code with its own SQLite file,
Qdrant collection, principals file and the evidence
Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. Every request gets
an X-Request-ID and one structured log line.
